---
title: "The Cato Institute’s 25th Annual Monetary Conference"
date: "2007-11-15"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

The Cato Institute held its [25th Annual Monetary Conference](http://www.cato.org/monetary/program.html "25th Annual Monetary Conference") yesterday.  Fed Chair Ben Bernanke used the occasion to [announce](http://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/speech/bernanke20071114a.htm "announce") some important enhancements in the transparency of the Federal Reserve’s economic forecasts.  The WSJ’s [RTE blog](http://blogs.wsj.com/economics/2007/11/14/scholars-react-to-feds-communications-changes/ "RTE blog") has a round-up of reactions to the changes.
